title: TRaSH Guides
subtitle: Push quality profiles, custom formats, sizes and naming from the TRaSH Guides to Sonarr and Radarr, and keep them in sync.

guide.skipped_one: {{count}} guide file could not be read and was skipped
guide.skipped_other: {{count}} guide files could not be read and were skipped
guide.updated: New guide version loaded. Instances with a template are checked now.
guide.upToDate: The guide is up to date.

instances.noneBody: Connect Sonarr v4 or Radarr in the settings. Other products have no TRaSH Guides data.
instances.firstTemplate: Start with a template: pick TRaSH profiles once and use them for as many instances as you like.
instances.guideDrift_one: {{count}} change from the guide or template
instances.guideDrift_other: {{count}} changes from the guide or template

guardHelp.off: Wardarr does not check this instance.
guardHelp.notify: Wardarr checks regularly and reports differences in the Issue Center. Nothing changes without you.
guardHelp.auto: Changes of the guide and template are applied on their own, each with a backup. Changes made in the instance are only reported.
guardHelp.strict: Like auto sync, and changes made in the instance are set back to the template too.

body.auto: Wardarr will change custom formats, quality profiles, sizes and naming of this instance on its own whenever the TRaSH Guides or the template change. Every change is backed up and can be undone in the history. Large changes still wait for you.
body.strict: Wardarr will also set back every change someone makes in the instance to the managed settings. Use this only if no other tool such as Recyclarr manages them. Every change is backed up and can be undone in the history.

preview.title: Sync {{instance}}
preview.subtitle: Template: {{template}}
preview.firstSync: First sync: existing custom formats and profiles with the same name are taken over instead of being created twice.
preview.brakes: The guard would not apply this on its own: {{reasons}}.
preview.inSync: The instance matches the template. Nothing to do.
preview.removals: Remove custom formats the template no longer uses
preview.removalsHelp: Only formats Wardarr created or took over. They are part of the backup.
preview.backupNote: Wardarr backs up everything it changes first. You can undo the sync in the history.
preview.backupKept: The backup is in the history.

warning.unknownFormat: {{profile}} uses a custom format the guide no longer has ({{id}}).
warning.unknownProfile: The guide no longer has a profile of this template ({{id}}).
warning.unknownGroup: The guide no longer has a format group of this template ({{id}}).
warning.conflict: {{profile}} combines formats the guide says not to combine: {{formats}}.
warning.unknownQualitySize: The guide no longer has the chosen quality sizes ({{id}}).
warning.unknownNaming: The guide no longer has the naming "{{variant}}" for {{setting}}.

changelog.title: Guide changes
changelog.empty: Changes of the TRaSH Guides appear here after the next update.

templates.noneBody: A template names the TRaSH profiles, format groups, own scores, sizes and naming an instance gets.

editor.name: Name
editor.productFixed: For {{product}}. The product of a template cannot change.
editor.profileGone: The guide no longer has this profile.
editor.profileNameHelp: Leave empty to use the guide name. An existing profile with this name is taken over.
editor.noGroups: The guide has no format groups for this profile.
editor.scoresHelp: Scores come from the guide (score set "{{set}}"). Your own score replaces it and stays when the guide changes.
editor.renameHelp: Sonarr or Radarr renames files to the chosen scheme on import.
editor.saveNote: Saving changes nothing in your instances. Instances with this template are checked and show the differences.
editor.deleteBody: The template is removed. Settings already synced to instances stay as they are.

history.noneBody: Every sync and every rollback appears here, with its backup.
history.undoBody: Wardarr restores every custom format, profile, size and naming setting as it was before this sync and removes what the sync created. The guard of the instance switches to notify, so it does not apply the change again.

test.intro: Enter a release name. The instance itself parses it, so you see exactly which custom formats match and which score it gets in each profile.

settings.local: Wardarr reads the TRaSH Guides from a local folder (WARDARR_TRASH_DIR).
settings.repoHelp: owner/name on GitHub, for example a fork of TRaSH-Guides/Guides.
settings.maxAutoChanges: Most objects the guard changes on its own
settings.backupsHelp: Older syncs stay in the history without a backup.
settings.license: The TRaSH Guides are published by the TRaSH Guides team under the MIT license. Wardarr downloads them at run time and does not ship them.

errors.guideMissing: The TRaSH Guides have not been downloaded yet.
errors.guideFetchFailed: The TRaSH Guides could not be downloaded. Wardarr keeps the last version.
errors.templateInUse: Instances still use this template. Give them another template first.
errors.noTemplate: Choose a template for this instance first.
errors.syncFirst: Sync once by hand before the guard may sync on its own.
errors.wrongProduct: The template is for another product.
errors.noBackup: There is no backup for this sync any more.
errors.alreadyRolledBack: This sync was already rolled back.
errors.productFixed: The product of a template cannot change.
